settings.heading: Can testing support disciplinary or legal processes?
settings.text: Testing must operate within the agency’s policy, consultation framework, applicable law and chain-of-custody requirements. Seek appropriate legal or industrial-relations advice for decisions with disciplinary or evidentiary consequences.

settings.heading: Can you support multiple agencies and sites?
settings.text: Programs can be structured around multiple facilities, operational groups, contractors and regional locations, with consistent equipment, procedures, training and reporting.

settings.heading: How is chain of custody maintained?
settings.text: The process should define authorised collection, sample identification, secure handling, documented transfer and accredited confirmation where required.

settings.heading: How do you support procurement and tender requirements?
settings.text: Andatech can provide relevant product, calibration, service, training and program documentation for your procurement team to assess against its requirements.
